# GymRollins Trademark Policy

"GymRollins" and the GymRollins logo are trademarks of the GymRollins maintainer (GitHub: @dmitryrollins),
whether registered or unregistered. The source code of GymRollins is open source under the licenses described
in [LICENSE](../LICENSE); those licenses do not grant any rights to use our trademarks.

The goal of this policy is simple: anyone should be able to say truthfully that they use, build on, or
contribute to GymRollins, and nobody should suggest an affiliation with or endorsement by GymRollins that does
not exist, or confuse users about what comes from us.

## You can, without asking

- Build, run and self-host GymRollins, modified or not, for yourself, and say that you do.
- Make truthful statements such as "built on GymRollins", "compatible with GymRollins" or "a fork of GymRollins".
- Use the name "GymRollins" to refer to the project in articles, talks, tutorials, reviews and comparisons.
- Link to the project and use unmodified screenshots of the app.

## You need our written permission to

- Use "GymRollins" or a confusingly similar name in the name of your company, product, service, domain name,
  social media account, or app store listing.
- Publish a build of GymRollins, or of a fork, on the App Store, Google Play or any other app store under the
  GymRollins name or icon.
- Market a hosted, managed, or modified version of GymRollins in a way that suggests it is an official
  GymRollins offering, or is endorsed by or affiliated with GymRollins.
- Use the GymRollins logo or app icon as, or as part of, your own logo or branding.

## Forks

You may maintain and distribute forks of the source code under the terms of the applicable licenses. If you
distribute or operate a fork publicly, give it its own name, icon and bundle identifier. You may state
truthfully that it is "a fork of GymRollins", but do not use the GymRollins name or logo in a way that
suggests your fork is the original project.

## Questions

If you are unsure whether your use is allowed, or want to request permission, open an issue on GitHub.
